body: Southwest Airlines plans to introduce the Boeing 737 MAX 7 into passenger service in March 2027, according to an internal rollout document obtained by View From The Wing. Deliveries are expected to start in December 2026, with the airline initially operating 27 already-built aircraft and newly manufactured examples arriving from February 2027. Before entering commercial service, each aircraft will undergo configuration work, maintenance and validation flights, including a simulated extended overwater operation lasting more than 3.5 hours.

The debut follows the Federal Aviation Administration's type certification of the MAX 7 on August 3, which cleared the way for deliveries to Southwest, the variant's launch customer. The aircraft will feature 150 Recaro seats, including designated extra-legroom seating, along with Starlink connectivity, in-seat power, larger overhead bins and three lavatories, up from two on Southwest's 737-700s. That is 13 more seats than the 137-seat 737-700, an increase of about 9.5%, while stopping at 150 seats avoids the additional flight attendant generally required in the United States for aircraft configured with 151 or more passenger seats.

Southwest intends to include the MAX 7 in its published schedules before the end of 2026, although the March 2027 introduction remains subject to change as operational preparations continue. The first 27 aircraft can gradually take over extended overwater missions currently flown by older 737-800s, such as Burbank-Honolulu, Phoenix-Hawaii and Las Vegas-Hawaii, freeing the 737-800s for reassignment elsewhere in the domestic network. The MAX 7 is also central to replacing Southwest's older 737-700s, many of which have been in service for about two decades.
en.summary: Southwest plans to debut the Boeing 737 MAX 7 in passenger service in March 2027 with 150 seats, 13 more than its 737-700s, after deliveries begin in December 2026.
en.title: Southwest's Boeing 737 MAX 7s to debut in March 2027 with 150 seats

body: 西南航空計畫於2027年3月讓波音737MAX7投入載客服務，首批飛機預計自2026年12月起交付，初期營運27架已製造完成的飛機，新造機則自2027年2月起陸續交機。每架飛機投入商業營運前，都要完成構型調整、維修與驗證飛行，其中包括一次超過3.5小時的模擬延伸越水飛行。

這次引進是在美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）於8月3日授予737MAX7型別認證之後，認證掃除了交付障礙，西南航空作為該機型的啟始客戶開始準備接收首批飛機。新機將配置150個Recaro座椅，包括加大腿部空間座位，並配備Starlink連網、座椅電源、加大行李艙與3間廁所，比西南航空737-700的2間多1間。150座比137座的737-700多13座，增幅約9.5%，而停在150座則可避免觸發美國對151座以上飛機增派空服員的一般規定。
西南航空打算在2026年底前把737MAX7納入已公布的班表，但2027年3月的引進時程仍可能隨營運準備工作而變動。首批27架飛機可逐步接手目前由較舊737-800執飛的延伸越水任務，例如伯班克—檀香山、鳳凰城—夏威夷與拉斯維加斯—夏威夷，讓737-800轉調國內線其他航線。737MAX7同時也是汰換西南航空737-700的關鍵，許多737-700已服役約20年。
